Phase 01 is fail-closed: narration cannot begin until the compiled writer brief contains nonempty rhythm_direction and narrator_vibe, and Content Review cannot open until required narration artifacts and actual validator receipts exist. Preserve sourced evidence, approved narration and genuine user reviews. Fresh 2.6.19+: HumanWriting may be routed only for observed natural_voice/formulaic_language/audience_fit narration weaknesses and must preserve semantics, facts, claims, Zodiac identity, progression and payoff. Fresh 2.7.0+: read skills/zodiac-affiliate-commerce/SKILL.md and persist the Affiliate YES/NO gate before commerce work. If YES, Kalodata is canonical and Story Fit outranks commission. Never use dismissive return lines that imply the product is unnecessary or irrelevant after CTA. Canonical execution-source rule: in ChatGPT the verified phase-scoped execution bundle matching the installed release/commit and active phase is the only executable source.
